prompt:
You are evaluating reported NYPD complaints, NOT individual visitor safety. For EACH supplied NYC police precinct, assign an integer rating from 1 to 5, where 1 means fewest reported incidents and 5 means most, relative to NYC precincts. Also estimate its average reported incidents per month. Return JSON ONLY in this format: {"predictions":[{"precinct":"1","rating":3,"estimated_monthly_incidents":100.0}]}. Include every precinct exactly once. Do not invent additional precincts. The supplied actual_monthly_avg values are verified monthly averages for 2022-2024. Use these values as the basis for your estimates and ratings.
